$description: Commerce templates (platform/templates/Commerce), library wave 13, lane A: their region tokens. The space between a page's parts, its sections and its columns; the summary column's width; the page title and section titles (the title roles, as Text title and heading); the lines of a cart or an order (the divider, the picture column, the line total's least width); the order summary's rows (the data font for amounts, the strong total). Every component inside keeps its own tokens.

commerce-gap.$description: Commerce: the space between a page's parts (space-stack-lg).

commerce-head-gap.$description: Commerce: the space inside the page's head, under the title (space-stack-xs).

commerce-section-gap.$description: Commerce: the space inside a section, between a title and its content (space-stack-sm).

commerce-inline-gap.$description: Commerce: the gap between things side by side: links, buttons, a field pair (space-inline-sm).

commerce-columns-gap.$description: Commerce: the gap between the main column and the summary, or the pictures and the buying column (space-layout-md).

commerce-aside-width.$description: Commerce: the summary column's width (320px); one column on a narrow page.

commerce-search-width.$description: Commerce discovery: the search's widest width (560px).

commerce-title-text.$description: Commerce: the page and section titles (content-default).

commerce-title-font-family.$description: Commerce: the titles' font (font-heading, as Text title).

commerce-title-font-size.$description: Commerce: the page title's size (20px, as Text title).

commerce-title-font-weight.$description: Commerce: the page title's weight (bold, as Text title).

commerce-title-line-height.$description: Commerce: the page title's line height (snug).

commerce-subtitle-font-weight.$description: Commerce: a section title's and a legend's weight (semibold).

commerce-subtitle-line-height.$description: Commerce: a section title's line height (20px).

commerce-focus-outline-color.$description: Commerce: the ring on the confirmation's title when it takes the focus by keyboard (focus-ring-color).

commerce-focus-outline-offset.$description: Commerce: the title's focus ring offset (focus-ring-offset).

commerce-focus-outline-width.$description: Commerce: the title's focus ring width (border-width-medium).

commerce-line-border-color.$description: Commerce: the divider between the lines of a cart or an order, and above the total (border-divider).

commerce-line-gap.$description: Commerce: the gap between a line's columns (space-inline-md).

commerce-line-row-gap.$description: Commerce: the gap between a line's rows on a narrow page (space-stack-xs).

commerce-line-padding-block.$description: Commerce: a line's space above and below (space-inset-sm).

commerce-line-text-gap.$description: Commerce: the space between a line's name, options and price (space-stack-xs).

commerce-line-total-width.$description: Commerce: a line total's least width, so the totals line up (80px).

commerce-line-total-font-family.$description: Commerce: a line total in the data font (DM Mono), at the line's size.

commerce-line-total-font-weight.$description: Commerce: a line total's weight (semibold), the figure people check.

commerce-placeholder-background.$description: Commerce: a line's picture fill when there is none (surface-sunken).

commerce-placeholder-text.$description: Commerce: the picture icon of a line without one (content-subtle).

commerce-summary-gap.$description: Commerce: the space between the summary's rows (space-stack-xs).

commerce-summary-label-text.$description: Commerce: a summary row's name (content-muted); the total's is the title color.

commerce-summary-value-font-family.$description: Commerce: the summary's amounts in the data font (DM Mono).
